runnerManager.testTitle: Set Timezone command returns a per-device run reaching terminal status
runnerManager.testDescription: Tier 1 contract: POST connectivity/device-command/set-timezone behaves as above, and short-circuits with skipped=true plus an empty device list when no biometric-kiosk devices exist.

runnerManager.testTitle: Web per-device result and log output matches legacy for the same device set
runnerManager.testDescription: Tier 2 parity, host-bound: the web per-device result/log output — device set, per-device statuses, one file per device and MessageType.Single — matches the legacy baseline for the same devices. Needs PET_DEVICE_CMD_EQUIV=1, live send and a baseline file that only exists on the windows-automation host.

runnerManager.testDescription: Same no-filter branch on the crews handler, which shares the scoping helper.

runnerManager.testDescription: PET-441: a crew-scoped user sees a strict subset of the admin employee list, every visible row carries the assigned crew id, and the crews endpoint returns exactly that one crew. Skips when the restricted fixture was not provisioned.
